observations: Two round tables: one larger center table, one smaller side stool.
White tops with grey/brown veining, resembling marble.
Black conical bases for both pieces.
Gold-colored ring detail at the neck of the smaller table's base.
Watermark 'DVAULT INTEGRATED SERVICES' visible across the center.
Staged setting with a shaggy rug and paneled wall background.

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the edge and underside of the table top.

risks.risk: Base material and stability (could be thin metal or plastic).
risks.proof: Video of the table being tapped or moved to hear the resonance.

risks.risk: Hidden surface scratches or chips on the tops or bases.
risks.proof: High-resolution close-up shots of the table tops and base edges.

Photo of the underside of the tables where the top meets the base.
